rule.name: Payout calculation
rule.risk: Overpayment, negative payout, or policy-limit bypass.
rule.contract: For an otherwise accepted request, payout_cents = min(max(amount_cents - deductible_cents, 0), limit_cents). Read deductible and limit from plans.json. All V1 plans deliberately use a synthetic 10000-cent deductible and 200000-cent cap per evaluation. At or below the deductible, return approved / COVERED with zero payout. This is not an annual accumulator, actual Medicare deductible, allowed-amount calculation, or real benefit payment.
